title: Mirabel and the Will
author: Jude Ashgrove
blurb: Ansel Sterling, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
